subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should the WebChat send shortcut be a scoped browser UI setting, a gateway/openclaw.json config option, or both?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful and aligned with frontend ergonomics, but it adds a new user-facing preference/config surface and the open PR is blocked on that owner/scope decision.

options.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
options.body: Store the preference with the existing gateway-scoped Control UI settings, refresh the linked PR, and keep gateway config unchanged.

options.title: Add Gateway Config
options.body: Require a documented openclaw.json/gateway config option, with schema/docs and upgrade proof before merging the feature.

options.title: Decline The Preference
options.body: Keep plain Enter-to-send as the only WebChat behavior and close the linked feature cluster with that product decision.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
recommendation.body: Store the preference with the existing gateway-scoped Control UI settings, refresh the linked PR, and keep gateway config unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Control UI ownership and prior triage make Peter the best available decision router for the settings-scope/product choice.
